from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re
ROOT=Path.cwd()
R33="reports/research/510300_dr007_transaction_amount_history_acquisition_v1"
OUT=ROOT/R33
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
old_paths=["research/calendar_liquidity_timing_v1.py","config/510300_calendar_liquidity_timing_v1.json",
 "reports/research/510300_calendar_liquidity_timing_v1/result.json","docs/510300_MONTH_EDGE_OPPORTUNITY_V1.md"]
for p in old_paths:assert (ROOT/p).is_file()
src=(ROOT/old_paths[0]).read_text(encoding="utf-8");old=json.loads((ROOT/old_paths[2]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert "remaining_calendar_days_scaled" in src and "quarter_last5_calendar" in src and "month_phase_sin" in src
assert 'for kind in ("RIDGE", "ET")' in src
rx=re.compile(r'days_to_(?:month|quarter)|(?:month|quarter)_end|距.*(?:月末|季末)|日历.*(?:跨月|跨季)|(?:月末|季末).*(?:特征|输入|评分|分层|因子)|(?:特征|输入|评分|分层|因子).*(?:月末|季末)',re.I)
count=0;matches=[]
for root in ["research","config","docs"]:
 for p in (ROOT/root).rglob("*"):
  if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in {".py",".json",".md"}:
   count+=1
   for i,line in enumerate(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines(),1):
    if rx.search(line):matches.append({"path":p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),"line":i,"text":line[:500]})
review={"at":datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat(),
 "status":"NOT_REGISTERED_CALENDAR_CANDIDATE_EXISTING_INFORMATION_AND_NONLINEAR_USE_ALREADY_COVERED",
 "hypothesis_considered":"以当时可知距月末/季末日期作为原订单/资金评分条件，研究同利率在不同日历阶段的差异。",
 "bounded_review":{"roots":["research","config","docs"],"extensions":[".py",".json",".md"],"files":count,"matches":matches},
 "actual_existing_calendar_fields":["remaining_calendar_days_scaled","month_phase_sin","month_phase_cos",
 "year_phase_sin","year_phase_cos","month_last5_calendar","quarter_first3","quarter_last5_calendar","month_edge"],
 "actual_existing_models":"旧日历/价格/FULL的RIDGE与ET非线性模型、固定日历规则与账户均已运行。",
 "old_primary_status":old["status"],"old_any_candidate_point_target":old.get("any_candidate_point_target_in_both_costs"),
 "decision_reason":"月末/季末/剩余自然天数不是尚未使用的原始原因输入；当前未证明改变名称、连续表达或联合使用与旧日历家族有实质不同。不因访问不足改旧窗口/参数重开。",
 "limits":"这是当前候选旧用途核对，不是证明日历永久无效，或全部历史策略逐项科学复核。",
 "calendar_not_added_to_original_fixed_daily_model":True,
 "new_experiment_id_registered":None,"new_fits":0,"new_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0,
 "references":[{"path":p,"sha256":sha(p)} for p in old_paths]}
p=OUT/"本地日历候选_旧用途核对与不重开裁决.json";assert not p.exists()
p.write_text(json.dumps(review,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"日历候选":"旧字段及非线性用途已覆盖，本轮不登记重跑","原主方案":old["status"],"新增模型":0},ensure_ascii=False))
